line: I've started on the morning meal; I'll see if it tastes better than yesterday's burnt batch.

context.trigger: You and Kit are in the courtyard again, the day after the fight.
context.speaker: Cy

text: I just want a proper table to eat at, not this...
label: slight
line: Funny, this workshop is a bit too pristine for some of us, um...

context.trigger: Cy has just walked into the workshop where you are working.
context.speaker: Kit

text: I just want this to be over, the quiet to finally come.
label: none
line: Enough. Just let the fog settle.

context.trigger: Your brother Hale was buried this morning; Ana is standing beside you.
context.speaker: Dee

text: I just want him to eat something warm and stop being quiet.
label: kind
line: You alright, friend? Come help me with the stew while it simmers.

context.trigger: Your son Tam has been quiet since the raid and is sitting by the stove.
context.speaker: Ana

text: I just want to be left alone in the quiet.
label: none
line: Um... I'm managing, I suppose. Not much else to report on the interior, um...

context.trigger: Your mother asks how you are holding up after the raid.
context.speaker: Tam

text: I hope this marriage brings us a steady supply of good rations.
label: kind
line: Mara, if you'll permit it, we shall commence this ceremony before the evening meal.

context.trigger: You and Mara are about to be married; Kit is watching from the back.
context.speaker: Cy

text: I just needed to make sure the perimeter was secure.
label: slight
line: Look. I was checking the perimeter; a rifle costs more than sleep.

context.trigger: Ana asks why you were out of bed at night.
context.speaker: Bram

text: I hope she will eat something and not be angry.
label: kind
line: You haven't eaten, friend? Sit down, let me get you something.

context.trigger: Dee has not eaten since the funeral and you are sitting across from her.
context.speaker: Mara

text: Old Odo was steady, friend; he always made sure the rows were straight before he rested. What's next on the chopping block for supper?
Hale was solid, reliable. He was always there, always there.
Mara, your sustenance is my highest priority, we'll see what the next meal brings.
Cy, I will hold you through the winter and all the quiet light.
